text:
maya: Quick status: brought up ember-embed-3m on semantic-holdout-v5. did weight-only int8 and int4 mixes. posting short summary.
owen: cool — which quant backend and recipe?
maya: i used per-tensor symmetric for int8-w first, then per-channel for weights and weight+acts for int8-w+a. dataset seed=13. command:```
./eval_run --model ember-embed-3m --modes float16,int8-w,int8-w+a,int4-w --dataset semantic-holdout-v5 --seed 13 --norm l2 --batch 256
```
li: numbers? very curious about recall@5/10 and any cohort tails.
maya: brief table: float16 r@10=0.91 | int8-w=0.90 | int8-w+a=0.86 | int4-w=0.76. silhouette dropped 0.38->0.30 with int8-w+a, mean cosine shift pos ~0.02/0.05/0.09 for int8-w/int8-w+a/int4-w.
owen: int8-w looks fine. int8-w+a likely activation spikes. did you try clipping?
maya: tried 0.999 quantile clipping for activations: int8-w+a r@10 improved 0.86->0.88. also ran mixed strategy keeping proj-layer fp16: r@10 0.90, silhouette 0.36.
li: that mixed approach is promising. latency impact?
maya: perf numbers on canary runner: float16 P95=28ms, int8-w P95=22ms, mixed P95=23ms. good win. dashboard: https://redwood-internal/embeds/ember-3m/onboard/3890
eval-bot: Job 117223 completed: ember-embed-3m quick-onboard. artifacts -> dashboard.
infra-bot: note: int4 runs pushed memory on small-gpu nodes, we throttled concurrency to avoid OOMs.
owen: next steps: 1) li run per-layer cosine diffs to verify offending layers (assigned li). 2) maya run per-channel quant for proj-layer and activation clipping sweep (assigned maya). 3) prepare canary rollout plan and monitoring hooks (assigned owen).
li: started layer diff script, early signal shows projection "proj" block mean delta 0.11, others ~0.02. will post CSV.
maya: ack, will try per-channel on proj and upload artifacts.
owen: solid. document mixed-quant recipe in onboard doc and include k-range stability (1..50). we'll reconvene after artifacts. :thumbsup:
